content.text: Order Accepting Reliability Backstop Procurement and Establishing Further Procedures (ER26-3380-000 / EL26-108-000): The original order says it was issued September 29. It accepts PJM’s proposal for filing, suspends it for five months effective February 28, 2027, subject to refund and further proceedings, and establishes paper-hearing and FPA section 206 procedures. It identifies cost allocation, transmission-owner exit rules, and load-serving-entity collateral requirements for further consideration, while inviting a new section 205 filing that could expedite the procurement. (time=2026-09-29; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
